about.title: About MRT Kiasu
about.lead: MRT Kiasu tells you which door to stand at, so you step off nearest the escalator, lift, stairs, your exit, or your transfer.
about.whyBody: No official dataset maps train doors to escalators, lifts or exits. We checked LTA DataMall, data.gov.sg, SMRT and SBS Transit. Singapore's platforms carry no door numbering either. So this information has to be built by people who ride the network.
about.honestyBody: Every door position carries a confidence level, and we never blur them. A verified position means someone stood on that platform and checked it. An estimate is computed from where an exit surfaces — accurate to roughly 30 metres, which is why an estimate names a car and never a specific door.
about.dataBody: Every figure traces to a citable source or is computed from one. Where data does not exist, the app says so instead of guessing. A build-time check fails the release if any position lacks a source or points at an exit that LTA's data says does not exist.
about.contributeBody: Found a wrong position, an awkward translation, or something broken? Tell us — it goes straight to the people maintaining the data.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Short version: there are no accounts, no tracking, no cookies, and no third-party services running in your browser.
privacy.storedBody: Your language, theme, avatar, skin tone and exit preference are saved in your browser's local storage. They never leave your device, we cannot read them, and clearing your browser data removes them.
privacy.collectBody: Only what you type into the report form. The message is required; your name and email are optional and used solely to reply to you. Each report also carries the page you sent it from, your language setting and your screen size, so we can reproduce the problem. Nothing else is attached.
privacy.cookiesBody: None. The app sets no cookies at all, which is why you are not being asked to accept any. Local storage is used only for the preferences above — it is functional, not tracking.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: No analytics, advertising or tracking scripts. Fonts are served from our own domain, so your browser makes no request to Google. Live train data is fetched by our server from LTA DataMall — your browser never contacts LTA, and nothing about you is sent there. The only companies handling your data are our hosting and database providers, named above.
privacy.rightsBody: If you sent a report and want it deleted, or want to know what we hold, use the report form and say so. Reports are the only personal data we hold, and only if you chose to add your name or email.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.englishNote: These terms are written in English. Translations elsewhere in the app are provided for convenience; the English text governs.
terms.natureBody: MRT Kiasu is a free, unofficial tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Land Transport Authority, SMRT, SBS Transit, or any government body.
terms.accuracyBody: Door positions marked as estimates are computed, not observed, and may be wrong. Journey times are approximations, not timetables. Station data is only as current as its source. Use your own judgement, follow station signage and staff instructions, and never rely on this app where your safety depends on the answer.
terms.liabilityBody: The app is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for missed trains, missed connections, or any loss arising from using it.
terms.changesBody: These terms may change as the app does. The date above shows when they last did.
attribution.title: Data & credits
attribution.lead: This app is built almost entirely on public data. Every source and its licence is listed here.
attribution.ltaBody: Station codes and names, station exits, real-time platform crowding, service alerts and lift maintenance. Contains information from LTA accessed via data.gov.sg and LTA DataMall, made available under the Singapore Open Data Licence.
attribution.osmBody: Landmarks near each exit are derived from OpenStreetMap data, © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL). Our derived landmark dataset is likewise available under ODbL.
attribution.wikiBody: Station opening dates, descriptions, depths and rolling-stock figures. Text from Wikipedia is used under CC BY-SA 4.0; Wikidata is CC0. Each station page links to the article it drew from.
attribution.translationBody: Interface text was written by hand. Station descriptions were machine translated and are labelled as such wherever they appear. None of the translations have been reviewed by native speakers yet.
attribution.fontsBody: Press Start 2P and Inter, both under the SIL Open Font Licence, self-hosted rather than loaded from a third party.
attribution.disclaimerBody: Use of these sources does not imply any endorsement by LTA, SMRT, SBS Transit, or the OpenStreetMap Foundation.

egg.durian.title: No durians
egg.durian.body: Banned on the MRT since 1988, for the smell. Uniquely among the prohibitions, with no fine attached — there is simply no regulation covering it. Just don't.
egg.chope.title: Choped.
egg.chope.body: A packet of tissue paper. The most binding contract in Singapore.
egg.anniversary: {years} years ago today, this was one of the first five MRT stations to open.
about.sourceBody: The code and the data are public, so anyone can check what the app claims and where it got it. Door positions are the hard part: almost all of them are still estimates, and each platform someone verifies helps every commuter who uses it afterwards. Corrections, surveys and better translations are all welcome.
env.betaHint: A pre-release build. Data and behaviour may differ from the live site.
privacy.retentionBody: Reports are stored in a database run by Neon, our database provider, and the app itself is hosted by Vercel. Nobody else has access. We keep a report until the problem it describes is fixed, then delete it; ask us sooner and we will delete it sooner.
